acceptanceCriteria: Close and cleanup instructions have one executable ordering and cleanup failure is represented separately without reopening verified work
Ordinary code Work Items are not blocked by absent derived tri-language pages, while explicit documentation and release routes retain their checks
Historical pending-close/finalization debt blocks only a declared dependency or conflicting scope and remains visible as a warning otherwise
A small no-resource Work Item can complete start through close without a documentation successor

Every canonical English, Chinese, Japanese, and AGENTS projection distinguishes resource-bound provider cleanup before close from post-close synchronization or closure-context cleanup; no instruction says the same resource-bound branch/worktree must be deleted both before and after close.
A regression gate rejects any canonical lifecycle projection that places resource-bound Work Item branch/worktree removal after close or describes close itself as performing that deletion.
goal: Separate verified work completion from cleanup, make documentation projection explicitly policy-driven, and scope historical debt to related work
intent: Remove lifecycle gate authority conflicts that create unnecessary successor and documentation closure chains
outOfScope: Release tags and public artifacts; existing historical .ai archive/evidence/decision bytes; unrelated runtime performance or language migration; deletion of branches/worktrees; v0.2.93 release

scenarioCoverage.expected: A small ordinary code Work Item can pass preflight and complete its lifecycle without pre-created tri-language projection pages or a documentation successor.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use a repository fixture with explicit derived documentation policy and a no-resource Work Item; assert start through close succeeds while docs-task and release routes remain enforced.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An archived pending-close or legacy-finalization record unrelated to the requested Work Item remains visible but does not block the ordinary Work Item entry path.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a status/lifecycle fixture with unrelated historical debt and a clean ordinary Work Item; assert warning visibility, no entry rejection, and fail-closed blocking for a declared dependency.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A verified Work Item remains complete when post-close cleanup is pending, and cleanup failure is reported separately without reopening the verified work result.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise the cleanup-pending projection and assert distinct work-result and resource-cleanup fields plus no contradictory close ordering.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Resource-bound Work Item instructions require the exact provider-bound branch/worktree cleanup and its identity-bound finalization verification before close; post-close cleanup is limited to the closure/control context.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the focused resource_finalization_policy_test.sh gate and verify its negative fixture rejects a resource-bound order that places branch/worktree cleanup after close.
